Which size am I?

30-day returns, postage paid. Nothing on this site can actually be purchased.

Knitted in Kinross merino on a fine gauge. The rib is cut to 6 cm under the body measurement and stretches to meet it — which is why it looks small flat and fits close on. Size up only if you want it loose.

Shown in size S on a 178 cm frame measuring 84–66–92.

Care

  • Hand wash cool
  • Dry flat
  • Never hang
